Olga / Laura — quick PO notes and onboarding steps from Finance/Procurement side: 

1) PO routing: send PO to accounting@redwood-inference.com and CC procurement@redwood.com. Our AP accepts electronic POs in PDF/XLS and prefers a PO number in subject.
2) Standard terms: Net 30 from invoice receipt, USD. Tax: we require supplier tax form if US-based (W-9) or equivalent VAT registration for EU vendors. MarrowTech is US-based per Jamie so ask for W-9.
3) Supplier onboarding form: yes — we need a short supplier intake (name, legal entity, tax id, remit address, invoicing email, contact) filled out before creating the vendor record. I attached our PO template and the supplier intake checklist.
4) Banking: we will not share vendor banking until you create the vendor record internally. MarrowTech should send invoices to ap-invoices@redwood-inference.com once PO is issued; include PO number.

I recommend we: (a) have Laura confirm DPA redline items, (b) Olga send an onboarding packet (supplier intake + PO template) back to Jamie, (c) ask Jamie to return W-9 + signed DPA via DocuSign link.

Attachments: PO_Template_Redwood.xlsx; Supplier_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf

Karthik Iyer
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
